scientific_intent.scientific_task: Solve Ax=b by GPU forward Gaussian elimination followed by host backward substitution.
scientific_intent.mathematical_operation: m_it=a_it/a_tt; a_ij-=m_it*a_tj; b_i-=m_it*b_t for i>t,j>=t; host back substitution of resulting upper triangular system.
scientific_intent.discretization_or_topology: Dense row-major128x128 Float32 matrix with exponential Toeplitz a_ij=10exp(-.01|i-j|), rhs1 and separate full multiplier array.
invariants: Pivot row remains unchanged within each fan2 launch.
Exactly one column-zero lane updates each lower-row rhs per pivot.
Original Ax-b scaled infinity residual <1e-5 on named fixture.
accuracy_requirements: All33024 A,b,m,x scalar values checked; full intermediateatol1e-4 and source solutionatol1e-3.
Independent pivoted Float64 solve requires solution maxerror<=1e-3; all finite and scaledresidual<1e-5.
scientific_intent.precision_sensitivity: Float32 elimination without pivoting can amplify rounding and depends on nonzero pivots/conditioning; general input stability is not established.
scientific_intent.input_size_regimes: NamedN128 with254 kernel launches, one complete forward pass pertrial; native4096 and input-file workloads unmeasured.
scientific_intent.community_use_case: Dense linear-system algorithm primitive; source has no particular PDE, physical model or application dataset.
scientific_intent.uncertainty: Toeplitz source generator is a synthetic solver test, not evidence of domain-science validation.
